title: Zeus Ion 510 Battery
description:
The first 510-thread battery made by Zeus Arsenal. The Ion feels incredibly comfortable in your hand because it’s made with quality materials. It’s a small and portable 510 that’s also powerful and efficient. Its captivating, sleek design makes it a great conversation starter and can even double up as a decoration piece for your desk. All in all, this 510 threaded battery has arrived to set a new standard for premium quality and functional design.

Features:
• Premium 510 Battery
• 15 Second Pre Heat
• Compact Design
• 4 Multi-Color LED lights
• 2 Magnetic Adapters
• USB-C Charging (cable not included)

Cartridge not included

Purposefully cable-free. Most clients have a USB-C cable already. No clutter, no waste.
If you need one — we’ve got options.
